verdict.rationale: Orb documents managed daily exports of resource types to a data destination of your choice, plus cursor-paginated list endpoints, which supports bulk data export. The evidence does not name which resource types are covered, and nothing addresses porting stored payment methods to another provider. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that subscriptions, invoices, and raw usage events are all exportable, any documented payment-method portability or processor-to-processor card migration, independent or hands-on corroboration of a full exit export.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export every subscription, invoice, and usage record — and port stored payment methods out to another provider — if I choose to leave

citations.quote: Orb supports managed, daily exports of resource types to your data destination of your choice.
The Orb API implements cursor-based pagination on endpoints that list resources
Track recognized and deferred revenue with exports for financial systems.
